title: Zoot Fashion Scraper
description: Scrape product detail data from Zoot categories or individual product pages.

startUrls.title: Category or product URLs
startUrls.description: Provide Zoot category or product detail URLs. You can mix locales (cz, ro, sk).

label.description: Optional custom label to force the crawler route.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Stop the crawl after this many product detail records are stored.

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max requests per crawl
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Hard stop for the number of HTTP requests (category + product pages). Leave empty for unlimited.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Number of parallel HTTP requests. Lower this to be gentle with the target site.

minRequestIntervalSecs.title: Minimum delay between requests (s)
minRequestIntervalSecs.description: Minimum random delay (in seconds) between finished requests.

maxRequestIntervalSecs.title: Maximum delay between requests (s)
maxRequestIntervalSecs.description: Maximum random delay (in seconds) between finished requests.

navigationTimeoutSecs.title: Navigation timeout (s)
navigationTimeoutSecs.description: Fail the request if the page does not load within this timeframe.

requestHandlerTimeoutSecs.title: Request handler timeout (s)
requestHandlerTimeoutSecs.description: Maximum time to process each request before timing out.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify proxy or bring your own. The scraper falls back to direct connections if credentials are missing.
